notes.title: Steam Controller Support Added
notes.notes: After a little tinkering, I've gotten Rampart Tactics working with Steam Controllers.  I made a community controller profile to stream line the process if anyone wants to try playing it on the couch this weekend. Also, I'm tinkering with the idea of a Linux port of the game, I'm not sure if there's much interest in it, but I'd like to give it a try and see how well it goes.

notes.title: Steam Controller Support?
notes.notes: I was building a Linux box recently and noticed that it had built in support for Steam Controllers in the kernel.  This made me bust out the old Steam Controller, and got me thinking that maybe you all might like to use it to play Rampart Tactics, couch gaming style.  Its just a thought, and honestly I'm also just interested to know what you all think of the game.  Any feedback is appreciated, especially specific feedback that I can work on.
